command: (async()=>{if(new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('itemId')!=='2089239'||document.querySelector('.modal.show'))throw Error('Own239 required');const m=document.querySelector('#itemTwinModal'),r=document.querySelector('#twinCurrent');const shown=new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const timer=setTimeout(()=>reject(Error('Twin shown timeout')),7000);m.addEventListener('shown.bs.modal',()=>{clearTimeout(timer);resolve();},{once:true});});document.querySelector('[data-bs-target="#itemTwinModal"]').click();await shown;return {shown:true,currentText:r.innerText,addTab:document.querySelector('#twinAddTabBtn')?.getAttribute('aria-selected')};})()
